prospectus.strategy: XFUNDS TM Technology Income ETF (ticker: VGTX) The second paragraph of the Options Portfolio subsection of the Principal Investment Strategies section of the Prospectus and Summary Prospectus is hereby amended and restated as follows: The options strategies most frequently used by the Fund include put spreads and/or call spreads on individual securities held by the Fund in the Equity Portfolio, ETFs held by the Fund in the Equity Portfolio, ETFs that provide similar exposure to those held by the Fund in the Equity Portfolio, or on indices that track U.S. information technology companies. These options may be standard listed options or FLEX options traded on a U.S. exchange. In addition to spreads, the Fund may utilize stand-alone (also known as single-leg) options, including short call options (i.e., selling a call on an underlying security not owned) or cash-secured puts (i.e., selling a put while holding cash sufficient to buy the underlying security at the strike price). The first paragraph of the Fund Attributes subsection of the Principal Investment Strategies section of the Prospectus and Summary Prospectus is hereby amended and restated as follows: Under normal circumstances, the Fund will invest at least 80% of the value of its assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in (1) equity securities of information technology companies and ETFs that track U.S. information technology companies and (2) options on such securities or on U.S. information technology company indices. For purposes of the foregoing, the Fund defines information technology companies as those engaged in the development, manufacturing, or distribution of technology, communications and Internet-related products and services, including computer hardware and software, communications hardware and software, semiconductors, business services, and media and Internet-related services.
